role: post-hoc development test of a local-FD interpolation residual surrogate
decision_rule: Proceed only if the residual surrogate lowers mean full-record L2 by at least 5% versus the frozen neural checkpoint and improves at least 9 of 16 historical records.
limits: The 16 evaluation records were opened earlier. This one-seed, one-model, 5 Hz experiment is a structural development diagnostic and cannot be reported as independent validation, localization evidence or calibrated UQ.
